description: This file defines components and utilities for creating Discord interactive messages, including buttons, select menus, modals, and blocks, with support for dynamic component creation, validation, and message building.

classes.name: DiscordFormModal
classes.description: A class representing a Discord modal form with dynamic fields, extending ModalBase, capable of rendering and handling modal interactions.

methods.name: buildDiscordComponentMessage
methods.description: Constructs a Discord message with interactive components based on the provided specification, supporting blocks, modals, and nested components.

methods.name: buildDiscordComponentMessageFlags
methods.description: Determines message flags based on whether components are version 2.

methods.name: createDiscordFormModal
methods.description: Creates a Discord modal object from a stored modal entry.

methods.name: formatDiscordComponentEventText
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing a button or select component event.
